title: CORPUS17 — 17th c. French texts corpus
notes: CORPUS17 is Simon Gabay's open GitHub corpus of 17th-century French texts encoded in diplomatic TEI (e-ditiones/CORPUS17, live 200, description '17th c. French texts corpus'). The 120 collected texts (dates 1624-1687 etc.) mirror its TEI files. No explicit licence in repo metadata listed by the GitHub API. Origin verbatim: 'CORPUS17:  (1624)'. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, including retained duplicates; harvested subset).
license_note: Includes CC-BY-4.0. Licences or rights differ by text, corpus or editorial layer; consult the source terms for the selected material.
